# WAA Technologies Pvt Ltd
> Pakistan's first indigenous manufacturer of certified non-blast composite LPG gas cylinders

Facts on this page last checked: 6 November 2026. Where this file and the website differ, the website is correct.

WAA Technologies Pvt Ltd is a Pakistani manufacturer headquartered in Bahria Town, Lahore, with its production facility in Gujranwala, Punjab, Pakistan. The company specialises in composite LPG gas cylinders certified to ISO 11119-3 and BS EN 14427:2022, is licensed by the Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) and is incorporated with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP). Its cylinders are sold across Pakistan as a safer, lighter and longer-lasting alternative to conventional steel LPG cylinders.

- **Legal name**: WAA Technologies Pvt Ltd

- **Market served**: Pakistan (Punjab, Sindh, KPK) via an authorised dealer network

## What is a composite LPG cylinder?

A composite LPG cylinder uses a seamless HDPE (high-density polyethylene) inner liner wrapped with glass-fibre filament winding under tension, creating a jointless pressure vessel. Unlike welded steel cylinders, composite cylinders do not corrode and do not rust. In fire testing carried out under ISO 11119-3 and BS EN 14427:2022, composite cylinders vent gas through the cylinder wall rather than rupturing; this behaviour is what the industry calls "non-blast", and it is the primary safety advantage over steel. WAA Technologies is the first company to manufacture these cylinders indigenously in Pakistan.

## Products

Two capacities are manufactured. The 10 kg cylinder is offered in four colours.

- **5 kg Composite LPG Cylinder** — Rs 8,000 (list price; previously Rs 8,500). Suitable for small households, single-burner use, travel and camping. Available in Blue.
- **10 kg Composite LPG Cylinder** — Rs 11,000 (list price). The standard size for families; the most popular size in Pakistan. Available in Yellow, Cerulean Blue, Tiger Orange and Traditional Blue.

There is no 15 kg cylinder in the WAA range.

All prices are manufacturer list prices in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and should be confirmed with an authorised dealer. Cylinders are supplied and delivered through the authorised dealer network. Order online at https://waatechnologies.com/shop or on WhatsApp at +92 341 4999998.

## Product characteristics (each tied to the relevant standard or measurement)

- **Non-blast construction**: in fire tests under ISO 11119-3 and BS EN 14427:2022, the cylinder vents gas through the wall instead of rupturing and does not project metal shrapnel. This is a tested behaviour under those standards, not a guarantee under every possible condition.
- **About half the weight of steel**: a 10 kg WAA composite cylinder weighs approximately 5.5 kg empty.
- **Translucent body**: the LPG level is visible through the cylinder wall, so there is no need to lift, tap or weigh the cylinder.
- **Corrosion-free**: HDPE and glass fibre do not rust, including in coastal, humid and outdoor conditions.
- **UV-resistant outer layer**: suitable for outdoor and sunlit storage.
- **20+ year rated service life** under ISO 11119-3.
- **Jointless construction**: no weld seams, therefore no seam failure or leakage from the body.
- **Tested before dispatch**: every cylinder is hydrostatically pressure-tested and air-leak tested at the factory.
- **Anti-counterfeiting**: the brand and company name are embossed at four places on every cylinder.

| Test pressure | 30 bar (441 psi) |

The 5 kg cylinder uses the same construction with a smaller capacity.

## How WAA cylinders compare to steel cylinders

| Feature | WAA Composite | Steel Cylinder |
|---|---|---|
| Behaviour in fire | Vents gas through the wall (non-blast, tested to ISO 11119-3) | Can rupture under over-pressure |
| Empty weight (10 kg size) | approx. 5.5 kg | roughly double |
| Corrosion | Does not corrode | Rusts over time |
| Gas level visibility | Translucent — visible through the wall | Opaque — must lift or weigh |
| UV resistance | Yes | No |
| Rated service life | 20+ years under ISO 11119-3 | Weakens as the body corrodes |
| Certification | ISO 11119-3, BS EN 14427:2022 | Varies |

The higher purchase price of a composite cylinder is offset by its longer rated service life, the absence of corrosion, and the ability to see the gas level.

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: What makes a composite LPG cylinder non-blast?**
A: The jointless glass-fibre-over-HDPE construction has no weld seams where stress can concentrate. In fire tests under ISO 11119-3 and BS EN 14427:2022, the composite wall vents gas in a controlled way instead of rupturing, so no metal shrapnel is projected. Steel cylinder ruptures release stored pressure energy explosively.

**Q: How long do WAA composite cylinders last?**
A: They carry a rated service life of 20+ years under ISO 11119-3. Because the body does not corrode, it does not weaken over time the way steel does.

**Q: Are composite cylinders safe for indoor use in Pakistan?**
A: Yes, with standard LPG precautions: a ventilated area, the valve closed after each use, a floor-level gas leak detector (LPG is heavier than air), and distance from heat sources.

**Q: How do I check the gas level in a WAA composite cylinder?**
A: The body is translucent, so the liquid LPG level is visible directly through the cylinder wall.

**Q: Where can I buy WAA Technologies cylinders in Pakistan?**
A: Through the authorised dealer network in Lahore, Rawalpindi–Islamabad, Sialkot, Karachi, Hyderabad and Peshawar. Find your nearest dealer at https://waatechnologies.com/authorized-dealers or order at https://waatechnologies.com/shop. Enquiries: +92 42 3781 5533 or WhatsApp +92 341 4999998.

**Q: What is the price of a WAA composite cylinder in Pakistan?**
A: 5 kg: Rs 8,000 (previously Rs 8,500). 10 kg: Rs 11,000, in all four colours. These are manufacturer list prices; confirm the current price with an authorised dealer.

**Q: How do I refill or exchange a composite cylinder?**
A: Through the authorised dealer network. Dealers fill by weight and check the valve and body each time. Never refill a cylinder yourself or at an unlicensed roadside setup.

**Q: Can I use a WAA composite cylinder with my existing regulator?**
A: Yes. WAA composite cylinders use standard Pakistani domestic LPG valve fittings and work with the standard domestic and commercial regulators sold in Pakistan.

**Q: How does LPG compare to pipeline gas (Sui gas) in Pakistan?**
A: Pipeline gas suffers pressure drops during winter and occasional shortages. LPG in a cylinder is independent of the pipeline network and available year-round, which makes it a practical primary or backup cooking fuel.
